column1: # The patch log: what changed in the engine and when, one line each.
# Typed by hand like a changelog is; read by scripts/webapp.py for the
# Patches page. Newest first. Columns: date, area, note.

column3: Every lane tab sorts: probability, edge, league hitrate — highest first — plus overs-first and unders-first, which group by side and rank by probability inside the group. Cards carry their own keys, so no sort re-reads rendered text
Retrosim hitrates sort on any column, click again to reverse; a number opens on its largest, a name opens at A

The ledger of everything tried: 20 verified, 6 unfinished, 22 declined, typed once in config/hypotheses.tsv and rendered into both the README and the app — a rejected idea keeps the number that rejected it so it is not re-proposed

Retrosim badges were a day stale on all six cup codes — written before the signed gap shipped. Re-run: UCL 84.0 (+0.5), UEL 88.5 (+3.9), UECL 86.0 (+0.3), UCL-Q 82.5, UEL-Q 84.0, UECL-Q 84.8; the two big gaps closed from +4.4 and +4.2 to near zero
The Engine state block is now checked against the live code on every render — it had sat dated 24 Aug while DEFENSE_BLEND, the whole Club Elo lane and the 0.82 cup floor shipped underneath it
About gains a run-sessions section: what a run is, why the next run is the only honest test, and the arc from 84.2% at ROI −10.1% to a calibrated board

The +1% bar checked against this run's own settled rows: Tip 1 grades 75.0 held (says 82.7, gap -7.7), 86.7 at +1-3%, 100 at +3%+ — the withheld band is the only one that grades BELOW its stated probability. Confirms where the bar sits; 12 rows do not move it

The sweep was blind to three continents: ESPN files a fixture under the COMPETITION's local day, so a Chilean 18:00 sat on our previous date and was reported missing — neighbouring days are asked for too and merged

Club identity across sources hardened: ø/đ/ł/æ/ß folded (Lillestrøm was not Lillestrom) and translated names resolved through the nickname file (Red Star Belgrade is Crvena zvezda) — no fuzzy rule could ever have paired those
Live lanes state what the score has done to them — landed, needs N more, room for N, half gone — read from the ledger's own settlement, on every tab and in the README

One update is never one match: scripts/sweep.py checks every unsettled fixture against ESPN, grades finished ones on the 90 (extra time peeled off the scoreline) and refuses to leave neighbours stale; the renderer fails on any fixture four hours past kickoff with no result

The renderer now verifies itself: every fixture must appear on every surface it belongs to, tallies must match, the ledger must be complete and the app script must parse — a mismatch refuses to finish

Domestic context measured and declined: the mismatch term passes on residuals (t 3.81, both windows) but loses hitrate as tips (86.4 → 85.9 / 85.7); table position, three-season stature and the reverse fixture all fall short

SIGNED Elo gap shipped: the mu used |gap| only, pricing a strong home side exactly like a strong away side. Strongest term yet (t 4.95), improves both windows live — cup hitrate 83.3 → 84.3, pooled gap +0.1

First vs second legs profiled (5,341 legs): second legs run 2.81 goals against first legs' 2.59 and hold both windows, but first-leg caution has FADED (older −0.19 t −4.28, newer +0.02) — and against the engine's own mu neither leg is detectable, so no leg term
Level-aggregate second legs profiled (n 645): goals ordinary (2.74 v 2.67 usual), but home wins 49.1% and 21.7% go to extra time — decided at home, not through more goals
Two-legged ties measured: the aggregate adds nothing the engine's own mu has not already priced (t ≈ 1) — the apparent lead effect was the strength gap that created the lead
Two-legged ties get their aggregate printed beside the tip — first legs pulled from ESPN into config/first_legs.tsv, labelled context because the engine prices one match and cannot see the tie
Live headroom corrected: a quarter line's half-win band counts as room (U4.25 at 1-0 is room for 3, half from the 3rd), not a loss
Elo+form tested and declined: goal-tempo terms carry real signal (t 2.6, 2.1) but no window improves when graded — results-based form and Elo momentum are flat outright
PSG was mapped to Paris FC in the Club Elo table — 1969 vs 1538, a 430-point mispricing on every PSG cup fixture; found by auditing all 140 subset matches, one defect among them
Ask Athena: one club one identity — era-split spellings, Club Elo names and a nickname file (PSG, Barça, Spurs) all resolve to the same club
Board shipped as a web app (Vercel); README and app render from the same sources in one command
Cashout column finally read: a position cashed at stake settles at 1.00x immediately, never on the later result
Playable check: tightening cup EDGE hurts (winner's curse); tightening PROBABILITY helps — p≥87% lifts cup playable lanes to ~91-92% both seasons
Rule 6, the line-translation ladder: softer line first, printed line second, harder half-line only at buy≥ +0.07-0.10
Probability floor 0.82 on all six cup codes: hitrate-first selection, ~80→~83 at zero volume cost
Cup over-tips measured 3.5 points hot in both seasons, flat across bands — OVER_SAYS_DEBIT ships, windows close at +0.0/−0.1
CUPS REOPENED (probationary): Club Elo strength lane — 92% coverage, all windows same-signed, 202-fixture dress rehearsal hit 89.1%
Cup verdict chain: domestic form carries zero cup signal (slope 0.017); league bridge ratings real but one window short; Swiss-era club composite −0.6/−4.0
Rule 5 backtested on 6,354 pairs: pointed team lane real (78%), O0.5 tag is the trap, home+strong rung avoids defeat 83.9% — leg 4 becomes a number
DEFENSE_BLEND 0.5: team lanes finally see the opponent's defense (+7-11 pts); match mu measured and declined (~+1 pt, double-counts)
BIG_MATCH_DEBIT 0.15: top-6 clashes priced 0.15 goals lower; season-phase structure measured, relegation variant declined
NED-D2 launched same-day (check data → calibrate → futurematch); went 4-for-4 on its first slate
Card-layout board: every block derived from fixtures.tsv by board.py; the placed-bets block can no longer go stale
Cross-division fallback: promoted clubs priced from lower-division history at measured exchange rates (×0.754 scored, ×1.516 conceded)
TEAM_RATE_FLOOR 0.95 and the winner's-curse haircut moved into buy_from — hand rules become code
VENUE_BLEND swept and closed: a validated dead knob at 0.35
Playable bar raised to +1% edge; playable block moved above pending; three-lane header tracker
